channel.title: Evangelical Times Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: What has Jerusalem to do with Jerusalem?
item.description: Psalm 122 calls us to ‘pray for the peace of Jerusalem’ and to seek her good. But how, precisely, is the Christian to do that? Are we to pray for the literal city of Jerusalem, or should we understand the proper noun figuratively, and relate this exhortation to the Church?

item.title: Knit together in love: Manchester conference promotes unity among like-minded churches
item.description: Last December, we at Grace Fellowship Manchester organised our first conference in a few years. It was called the ‘Fellowship Conference Manchester 2025’ because it aimed to encourage fellowship between like-minded churches.

item.title: Honouring God through the discipline of physical exercise
item.description: ‘So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God’ (1 Corinthians 10:31). Just a few months ago I found myself staring at the bathroom scale in disbelief. I was sitting at 98kg, and I’m pretty sure I’d tipped over the 100kg mark in the months running up to that morning.

item.title: DR Congo: Eight Christians were beheaded in Christmas massacre
item.description: Eight Christians have been killed in yet another attack in north-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) on 26 December, an Islamist group has claimed.

item.title: Assisted suicide bill debate enters critical stage in House of Lords
item.description: The House of Lords has entered a critical phase in the debate over the Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill, as peers backed a motion to allocate further time for its scrutiny.

item.title: ‘Athanasius against the world!’ The momentous legacy of the Council of Nicaea explored in Newcastle conference
item.description: Seventeen centuries after 318 bishops gathered at Nicaea to confront the attack of Arius on the deity of Christ, delegates from around the world convened in the magnificent All Saints Presbyterian Church in Newcastle upon Tyne for a conference that would explore the legacy of that momentous event.

item.title: King faces criticism for multifaith Christmas speech
item.description: The King’s Christmas speech faced a backlash from evangelicals and conservative commentators for focusing on multifaith worship and ecumenical links with Rome.

item.title: Global: Blasphemy laws are fuelling anti-religious persecution across the world, according to expert
item.description: Blasphemy laws remain one of the most persistent and dangerous drivers of religious persecution worldwide, according to research quoted by a religious liberty watchdog.

item.title: How can I praise God through the menopause?
item.description: Fundamentally, I would encourage you to praise God through the menopause (perhaps, more specifically, the peri-menopausal experience) as you would praise him through other seasons of difficulty and challenge.

item.title: US: Christian author and speaker Philip Yancey admits to eight-year adulterous affair
item.description: American Christian author and conference speaker Philip Yancey has confessed to an eight-year adulterous affair with a married woman.
